description: This Kotlin source file implements a CallLogHandler class responsible for querying and handling call log data within an Android application. It includes data classes for representing call log records and search requests, an interface for data source abstraction, a system implementation of this data source, and methods for parsing search parameters and generating JSON responses. The code manages Android call log permissions, executes database queries for call logs, and returns results in JSON format, supporting search filters such as name, number, time range, duration, and call type.

classes.name: CallLogRecord
classes.description: Data class representing an individual call log record with fields for number, cached name, date, duration, and call type.

classes.name: CallLogSearchRequest
classes.description: Data class capturing parameters for searching call logs, including limits, filters by name, number, date range, duration, and call type.

classes.name: CallLogDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining methods for permission check and searching call logs.

classes.name: SystemCallLogDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing CallLogDataSource, querying the device's call logs via Android's ContentResolver.

classes.name: CallLogHandler
classes.description: Main class managing call log requests, permissions, parsing input JSON parameters, querying data source, and returning JSON results.

methods.name: hasReadPermission
methods.description: Method to check if the app has permission to read call logs.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs querying of call logs based on search request filters.

methods.name: handleCallLogSearch
methods.description: Handles a search request, checks permissions, parses JSON parameters, executes search, and returns JSON formatted results.

methods.name: parseSearchRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON string into a CallLogSearchRequest object with validation and defaults.

methods.name: callLogJson
methods.description: Converts a CallLogRecord object into a JSON representation.
